nom: BRMUD Deep Melting Mud Pore Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: I loved this product. I use it as a pre-cleanser to take off makeup. Pleasant natural smell. I have very dry skin and wash great for it.

I dont love it but I dont hate it. Basically no smell and its a pretty thick consistency. Does take my makeup off well. It doesn't wash off as easily as some others but its also not the worst I've tried (DHC). It just sometimes feels more hassel than it's worth I guess and I find myself reaching for other options more.
